registryBasis: The official Algerian Journal identifies a Direction du cadastre de wilaya de Laghouat and places it in the Biskra regional cadastre structure. The official ANESRIF Laghouat-Ghardaïa project document states that project survey data were overlaid on National Cadastre ArcGIS data. This establishes local/national cadastral custody evidence, not open parcel-service integration.
